hints.title: Missing Count Before Index
hints.text: At index m in a 0-indexed strictly increasing array, the count of missing positive numbers is arr[m] - (m + 1).

hints.title: Binary Search Monotonicity
hints.text: The missing count function is non-decreasing. Binary search for the smallest index where missing count is at least k.

hints.title: Answer Formula
hints.text: When binary search completes with left boundary low, the kth missing number is exactly low + k.

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Linear scanning takes O(N) time, whereas binary search runs in O(log N).
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Constant auxiliary space and logarithmic query time.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate identifies the monotonic missing elements relation arr[m] - (m + 1).
complexity.notes: Array is sorted in strictly increasing order.
